title: Paper reading tracker
idea: Help graduate students record notes on papers they read, tag them by topic and course, and export citations for their thesis.

docs.content:
# Current workflow
I keep notes in a messy Google Doc per course. I lose track of which papers support which thesis chapter.

# Existing stack
I know Python and Flask. Our lab server runs PostgreSQL.

title: Gym buddy matcher
idea: Match university students who want a workout partner based on schedule, gym location, and training goals, with in-app chat.

title: Pantry-based recipes
idea: Suggest recipes based on what is currently in a household pantry and fridge, and generate a shopping list for missing items.

title: Club event hub
idea: Let student clubs publish events, collect RSVPs, check in attendees with QR codes, and report attendance to the student union.

docs.content:
Student union requirements:
- Attendance reports exported monthly as CSV
- Only verified club officers may create events
- Accessibility: WCAG AA

title: Lab inventory
idea: Track chemical and equipment inventory in a research lab, with low-stock alerts and a checkout log for shared equipment.
constraints: Runs on a lab desktop, offline-friendly

title: Office hours queue
idea: A live queue for office hours where students join with a question topic and TAs see the queue, group similar questions, and mark students as helped.

docs.content:
# Course tools
Next.js frontend and FastAPI backend deployed on Render. Auth via GitHub OAuth.

title: Habit coach
idea: Help people build habits with daily check-ins, streaks, and weekly reflections that summarize progress and suggest adjustments.

title: Volunteer shift planner
idea: Let a food bank publish volunteer shifts, let volunteers sign up and swap shifts, and send reminders the day before.

title: Thesis figure manager
idea: Keep track of every figure in a thesis, the script and data that produced it, and regenerate all figures when data changes.

title: Campus carpool
idea: Coordinate carpools to campus for commuting students, matching by route and schedule and splitting fuel costs fairly.

title: Lecture flashcards
idea: Turn lecture slides into spaced-repetition flashcards that students can review and edit, with progress by topic.

docs.content:
# Design notes
Use the SM-2 spaced repetition algorithm. Students upload PDF slides. Cards must be editable before review.

title: Bug report triage
idea: Help a small open-source project triage incoming GitHub issues by detecting duplicates, labelling them, and asking reporters for missing details.
